name: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: David
visible.title: Solid lift kit easy install
visible.body: Easy install if you have a bit of knowledge me and my son did it in a little over 4 hours. Only recommendation the bolt for attaching the abs line is very fragile. Would beef this up on any redesign
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: Mitch
visible.title: Dont have to disassemble the struts with this kit!
visible.body: Installed it myself, directions are straight forward! Only adjustment was the toe. After the lift the tires have quite a bit of toe in. Got it in the ball park and sent for an alignment. I do not notice any ride quality or handling difference.
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: Michael
visible.title: Perfect Level
visible.body: Overall, very good kit. Leveled out the truck perfectly. Was kinda worried about the upper strut mounting bolts only having a couple threads to be torqued with the provided lock nuts. Took only a few hours to complete install.
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: MichaelS
visible.title: Must have 1.75 leveling kit
visible.body: Finally a truck owner at 62. It took long enough but better late than never. I loved the truck as stock but couldn’t be happier with the aggressive stance with the leveling kit. My mechanic raved about the quality of the materials. I’ve already had several people stop me to ask what I’ve done to the truck. Thanks American trucks for a great product
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: Rick
visible.title: Leveled within 1/4 inch front to back
visible.body: It leveled the truck within 1/4 inch front to back it handles better
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: CameronO
visible.title: Perfect level
visible.body: So far so good installed this past Friday and has drove great and looks great
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: Casey
visible.title: Great quality and easy install
visible.body: The quality of the control arms and spacers make this (in my opinion) one of the best leveling kits i have seen. Not to mention the easy to follow instructions that came with it. It mentions the torque spec on all the bolts and pictures to help show how to install them. Overall I would recommend this to anybody who is thinking about getting one.
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: TravisM.
visible.title: Perfect for 35s on Trail Boss
visible.body: This kit was simple, no tearing down the strut assembly. Top spacer, bottom spacer, new hardware, hardest part was getting the bottom strut bolts back in through the lower spacer as I did this myself. Great kit, little pricey for what you get but I’m happy with the results. Was able to fit 35x12.5 r18 ties with 2 inch spacers ( i don’t want to cut my factory studs) i will be getting new wheels at some point with the offer to be able to remove the spacer. Removed the front little mud flaps and metal bracket that just holds the fender liner, cut the front PLASTIC bracket that holds the front of the liner as that is it’s only purpose and tied that liner back front and rear. That was the only minor rub i had and I did not want to cut the liner so it worked great. Actually feel like it rides better with this kit than factory .. just my opinion.
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: RobertH67
visible.title: Easy Installation
visible.body: I was able to install this kit in about 3.5 hours without power or air tools. You definitely need a good pry bar to get the strut back into position to get the lower spacer in so the lower control arm can be bolted back to the strut.
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: Jamie
visible.title: Perfect level
visible.body: Great product, fast installation…ride and height is perfect. You will need front spacers if running bigger tires, the UCA will tire rub! I’m running 295’s
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: BlackTB
visible.title: Leveling Kit
visible.body: The truck sits 1/2 inch lower in the front after the installation, but definitely an improvement in removing the factory rattle. Truck drives almost as stock specially on the turning radius. Ride quality is the same as stock. I would recommend this product if you're looking for almost a factory like drive. Definitely looks cleaner and the upper control arms stand out more.
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: Alan42
visible.title: Great product
visible.body: Put my truck just a the right stance. Was just what I was looking for. Easy install!
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: Chevytrailboss4
visible.title: 1.75” level kit
visible.body: Awesome product. A little hard to do in your driveway by yourself but doable. Said I could clear 35’s. In paper work that came with it said 34’s. Haven’t bought tires yet till I get confirmation.
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.title: Control Arms
visible.body: Quality of this product was very good. Got delivered on time. The instructions for everything were very simple. Installed everything in about 2.5 hours. Cant even tell the difference in ride quality. Great product
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.title: Fits perfect
visible.body: Only thing that went wrong was that the crush nuts they supplied looked like they were crushed a little too far and I couldn't stop the ball joint from spinning so I just used the stock nuts. It rides good but different than stock obviously because the suspension geometry is different. Been running it for about 2 months and it's great
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.title: Easy install
visible.body: Lift installed relatively easy, I installed it in my garage, instructions were clear and concise. Made my 2022 trail boss sit perfect. my order was on time as usual with AT. I do think the kit is pricey but you get what you pay for. My front end alignment I had done was done with little adjustment by my tire shop, they said the lift was the reason why it was only on the rack 15-20 minutes. Recommend to anyone
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: Twicks
visible.title: Simple but right on the money.
visible.body: Went on smooth, feels like it drives better with the new control arms. Best upgrade I think you can do without compromising anything else and still get a good look.
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: Envy
visible.title: Great product
visible.body: Easy to install and great product love how smooth it rides
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: JOETORRE
visible.title: Truck is leveled
visible.body: This kit is of great quality it gave my truck the look I was looking for it got rid of the factory rake without compromising the steering and ride quality.
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: PAUPER
visible.title: You want this leveling kit!
visible.body: Bought 2, 1 for me and 1 for my sons truck. Great ride and stance with .5 inch spacer, 34 inch tires, and stock Trail Boss rims!!
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: Nuttin
visible.title: Missing parts
visible.body: The product is great quality and performs well. I was missing the caps for the grease fittings, consulted with customer service and should recieve some pending review!
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: LoganR
visible.title: Very impressive
visible.body: Impressed with how this leveling kit turned out on my 2022 LT trail boss stock height was 39” in the front and 41 1/4” in the rear after install it measured 41” in the front. Can’t beat that! Took 2-3 hours to install instructions were detailed including torque specs
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: BrettRhinehart
visible.title: 2020 Trailboss
visible.body: This kit leveled my truck out perfectly and I would recommend it to anyone the price was high but I felt like I needed the upper control arms
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: MSwigs
visible.title: Awesome ad.
visible.body: You can tell it’s on at first. Looks great and I’m not giving anything up on the ride. Fantastic product at a great price.
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: AdamF
visible.title: Looks better feels the same so far
visible.body: Truck looks better and handles the exact same so far. We will see with some more miles but I am happy with this purchase and install.
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: RCExhaust
visible.title: Trail Boss Level kit
visible.body: Along with this leveling kit, I purchased (4) 34" Mickey Thompson Baja Boss tires which gave my truck not only a leveled look but also lifted the truck another 2 inches from the factory 2 inch lift on my Trail Boss. Now it has a leveled aggressive stance and is set apart from the rest. This leveling kit made it perfectly leveled from the back and looks so much better than how it looks from the factory. I would highly recommend this product to anyone that wants a leveled Trail Boss. I also do not feel or see any difference in handling. However, the bigger tires did lower my MPG slightly but that was to be expected.
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: DavidAllenS
visible.title: Love this level!
visible.body: Bought the level kit and with the help of a few great friends it was installed in about 4 hours. Truck looks so much better sitting leveled. Hate the tires now so I will getting bigger tires next!
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: KentS.
visible.title: Easy as 1,2,3…. And a couple more.
visible.body: This product was very easy to install. I was fortunate enough to be able to do this on a lift and it made the install even easier. Simply follow the instructions and viola, you’re done. You will need to get an alignment done after. The reason I went with this kit is because it came with the upper control arms. If you’ve ever put on a leveling kit without them, you’ll know the stress that is put on your control arms, tie rod ends and ball joints. Overall, I would recommend this kit to anyone.
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)

visible.author: Jcook
visible.title: More impressive than you would think
visible.body: I didn't plan on upgrading tires right away, but the lift was way more noticeable than I ever would have guessed. Fit and finish was great. The UCA look so much better than stock, and can now fit around a 35" tire. Rides like stock. You wont regret it
visible.product: ReadyLIFT 1.75-Inch Front Leveling Kit with Tubular Control Arms (19-26 Silverado 1500 Trail Boss)
